text:
sarah: Quick signal — canary ramp to v2 (25%) just showed a small cluster of 5xx for a handful of tenants in us-west-2. Not widespread but consistent for the last 3 mins.
sarah: Seeing spikes tied to longer streaming sessions, likely client connection handling.
olivia: Thanks for the flag. Any tenant names?
sarah: acme-insurance, tinyshop-uk, and one internal test tenant. acme-insurance accounts for ~40% of the errors.
tim: Can you paste the failing request example? headers / payload?
sarah: Pasted sample below (sanitized):
```
POST /v2/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
User-Agent: mobile/1.4.2
Content-Type: application/json
{"input":"long streaming conversation...","stream":true}
```

matt: Looks like connection keepalive handling regressed in the v2 proxy layer. Might be related to the new chunked stream switch.
olivia: Given that it's tenant-specific and streaming-related, I'm leaning to pause the canary and pin the affected tenants to v1 while we investigate.
tim: Agreed. What do we want deploybot to do? Pause ramp and add pin for those tenant IDs?
sarah: Yes. Pause canary ramp immediately. Pin acme-insurance and tinyshop-uk to v1. Also add an operator note for us-west-2 for 30m.
deploybot: Deploybot reporting: Received request to pause rollout. To confirm: pause canary ramp to v2 and apply tenant pins: [acme-insurance, tinyshop-uk]. Reply with `confirm` to proceed.
matt: confirm
olivia: confirm
deploybot: Action accepted. Pausing v2 canary ramp now. Tenant pins applied: acme-insurance -> v1, tinyshop-uk -> v1. Operator tag: us-west-2/streaming-conn-hold.
sarah: :thumbsup: Thanks. Can someone open a quick postmortem ticket and assign to runtime-team? Put request id in the ticket.
devops-oncall: I'll spin up a debugging proxy in us-west-2 and try to reproduce with acme's traffic pattern. ETA 15m.
tim: If we confirm it's chunked-streaming, can we roll a hotfix to proxy or do we prefer to revert the proxy change?
matt: If it's a behavioral bug in proxy, hotfix is fine. If core runtime KV/caching interacts badly with streaming, safer to rollback. We'll triage with traces first.
olivia: Also updating release notes: remove the sentence that said "streaming improvements for long sessions" until we confirm.
sarah: I'll update #release-notes-drafts and tag @docs for a small edit.
devops-oncall: Reproducer running. I can trigger acme-like payload and capture tcpdump. Will share logs.
sarah: After we have logs, we'll decide next steps. If errors >20% for any tenant after 30m, we'll schedule an org rollback for v2 and signal customers.
matt: Agree on rollback threshold. Also let's add a telemetry rule to alert on streaming session 5xx by tenant so we catch this earlier.
olivia: I'll add the alert.
sarah: Thanks team. Will post updates here as we get traces.
deploybot: Note: Canary paused by operator action. Current canary traffic remains at 25% until operator ramps down.
sarah: Small follow-up: tagging legal/comms for acme-insurance notification draft if we need to proactively reach out.
olivia: Good call. I'll draft a short message in #customer-comms and share.
matt: Reproducer captured trace showing chunk boundaries being dropped on connection re-use. Suspect edge proxy HTTP/1.1 keepalive bug with chunked encoding.
tim: If that's confirmed, quick rollback of the proxy binary to previous release is low risk. Can we patch and test in staging in <1h?
devops-oncall: Staging reproduce is clean. I can roll proxy back in canary and validate then coordinate full rollback if green.
sarah: Plan: 1) Keep canary paused. 2) Pin affected tenants (done). 3) devops-oncall roll proxy back in a canary subset and run repro. 4) If green, roll forward proxy-only fix; else schedule org rollback of v2.
olivia: I'll update the rollout doc and the operator checklist.
sarah: Great. Please post the results in this thread.
matt: Will follow up with a short writeup once we confirm root cause.
sarah: thanks all — keeping eyes on logs.
